speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
text: asked the Minister for Health whether he can provide an update on the development and implementation of the five-year Child and Maternal Health and Well-being Strategy and Action Plan.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The efforts of the Taskforce are organised along three main thrusts.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: And third, we are reviewing our approaches to engage stakeholders and the public and to hear what matters most to them and to ensure that our messages and support to them stay relevant.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: One of my supplementary questions will be the involvement of the paternal part in this programme.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: We do understand that although this programme looks into child and maternal health, we do see the importance of others in this role.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: I hope that we can see more inclusion of fathers in the programme and in other programmes; and also, including the grandparents.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: My second supplementary question is on screening as part of this programme.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: With more screening, inevitably, we will have more interventions, most probably.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: When we talk about intervention, I would think that there is a need for the task force to engage the workplaces.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: These will help the provision of workplace support for mothers in the future.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: We are looking at this from a mother and child view, with respect to the science, because that is really where we have the research in terms of pre-conception, what happens in pregnancy, early neo-natal period.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: But getting things done, the service delivery kind of programmes and activities are really from a family-centric point of view.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: And so, the whole family is indeed encouraged to join in, to be part of this and to come along the journey.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: I hope that the fathers out there do not need a special invitation with their name.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: We are asking the whole family to turn up.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, as the father, he is part of the family, please come and get involved in looking after the young child and the young child's mother, and helping to support them through the journey.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The grandparents are naturally involved in very much part of the caregiving in our society.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, we take a family-centric view to involve the whole family.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: For the actual strategies around screening and interventions, these are still being studied and we have to look to see where we will implement programmes and activities.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: We will make the announcement in due course.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: But indeed, getting the right tools to make sure the interventions are effective are going to be important.
